chapter: Ma Rainey and the Palace Theater
title: Not realizing what the Ma Rainey job meant
summary: She says she only recently grasped the significance and recounts a rumor that Rainey was still alive.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: How exciting for you, though, at that age.
Regardless of how accomplished you were, you obviously were accomplished, but at that age to be able to do that.

Well, I don't think I really realized at that time what it meant. That's why I say many times now when I'm talking about, you know, things that happened in my past, I somehow forget about it, and just very recently we were talking or something, and I happened to mention it. I think some friends of mine were here from South America, and they are very, very into, you know, the history of musicians, black musicians particularly, and I happened to mention the fact, because they were thinking about another woman. Oh, somebody said that Ma Rainey is still alive. I don't know if this is
true or not. And the thing came up as to whether or not she was still alive, and somebody said she was still alive. I don't know, but if she is still alive, my God, she must be over 100 years old.
I hadn't heard that she was still alive.

Well, we heard this. We heard this recently, that she was still alive. But as I say, I don't know if that's true or not. But I didn't realize really, Pat, until just this short time ago, just a few months ago, you know, just what this really meant.
